      • AccelTypedVolatileImage

        public AccelTypedVolatileImage(GraphicsConfiguration graphicsConfig,
                               int width,
                               int height,
                               int transparency,
                               int accType)
        Creates a volatile image with specified type of accelerated surface.
        参数:
        graphicsConfig - a GraphicsConfiguration for which this image should be created.
        width - width
        height - width
        transparency - type of transparency requested for the image
        accType - type of the desired accelerated surface as defined in AccelSurface interface
        另请参阅:
        AccelSurface

        public Graphics2D createGraphics()
        Creates a Graphics2D, which can be used to draw into this VolatileImage. This method will throw UnsupportedOperationException if it this image's destination surface can not be rendered to.
        覆盖:
        createGraphics 在类中 SunVolatileImage
        返回:
        a Graphics2D, used for drawing into this image.
